title: Michigan court lets newer equal-pay claims proceed, bars older claims in $9,000 wage-gap case
summary_full: A contentious legal dispute has arisen at Michigan Medicine, centered around allegations of unequal pay for male and female physician assistants. Christine Oldenburg-McGee asserts that female employees are earning nearly $9,000 less each year than their male colleagues. The Michigan Court of Appeals has agreed to proceed with claims filed within a six-month window, but dismissed earlier claims due to procedural issues.
